einzeiler: Trump picks Stephen Miller as chief of staff, Congress faces a lame-duck session, and…
kurzfassung: President Trump has appointed hardliner Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff following midterm election losses, signaling a combative second term. Meanwhile, outgoing lawmakers return to Washington for a busy lame-duck session packed with must-pass legislation. NVIDIA is also investigating its CEO, Jensen Huang, over allegations of a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
stichpunkte: Stephen Miller takes over as White House chief of staff after serving as deputy.
Trump acknowledged that his mass deportation policy may have been too tough.
A lame-duck session of Congress tackles government funding and military bills.
House lawmakers weigh a potential impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.
NVIDIA's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair linked to Chinese intelligence.
Huang previously argued that allowing China to buy U.S. chips would slow down its domestic industry.
The Trump administration has loosened certain chip export controls affecting sales to China.

clips.hook: A presidential admission regarding harsh immigration measures.
clips.text: The commander-in-chief concedes publicly that the administration's removal strategy might have crossed the line.

clips.hook: Potential impeachment scrutiny for a cabinet member.
clips.text: A Kentucky representative initiates a push to remove the defense secretary from office.

clips.hook: Unprecedented access to the highest office.
clips.text: The tech executive maintained close contact with the administration, even joining an international presidential trip.

clips.hook: Congressional scrutiny adds pressure on leadership.
clips.text: Lawmakers demand private testimony regarding the executive's communications and foreign ties.

beschreibung:
President Trump says his immigration crackdown may have gone too far even as he elevates Stephen Miller, one of its chief architects, to run the White House after Republicans lost Congress.
Republicans are returning to Washington for a lame-duck session with a shrinking House majority and a short list of priorities, including funding the government, passing military spending and confirming Trump nominees.
Nvidia is investigating reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, raising new questions about one of the most important companies in the U.S.-China technology race.
